top_statements.Query: WITH counts AS ( SELECT queue, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'available') AS available, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'leased') AS leased FROM jobs WHERE state IN ('available', 'leased') GROUP BY queue ) SELECT q.name, q.max_depth, coalesce(c.available, 0), coalesce(c.leased, 0), CASE WHEN q.paused THEN 0 ELSE coalesce(( SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - min(o.run_at))::float8 FROM unnest('{1,2,3,4}'::smallint[]) AS p(priority) CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT j.run_at FROM jobs j WHERE j.queue = q.name AND j.state = 'available' AND j.priority = p.priority AND j.run_at <= now() ORDER BY j.run_at LIMIT 1) o), 0) END FROM queues q LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.queue = q.name

WITH next AS ( SELECT j.id FROM jobs j JOIN queues q ON q.name = j.queue WHERE j.queue = $1 AND j.state = 'available' AND j.run_at <= now() AND NOT q.paused ORDER BY j.priority, j.run_at, j.id LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE jobs j SET state = 'leased', attempts = j.attempts + 1, lease_token = gen_random_uuid(), lease_expires_at = now() + interval '1 millisecond' * coalesce($3::bigint, (SELECT visibility_timeout_ms FROM queues WHERE name = $1)) FROM next WHERE j.id = next.id RETURNING j.id, j.queue, j.kind, j.payload, j.priority, j.state, j.run_at, j.attempts, j.max_attempts, j.last_error, j.lease_token, j.lease_expires_at, j.idempotency_key, j.trace_context, j.created_at, j.finished_at, now()

INSERT INTO jobs (queue, kind, payload, priority, run_at, max_attempts, idempotency_key, trace_context) SELECT q.name, $2::text, $3::jsonb, $4::smallint, coalesce($5::timestamptz, now()), coalesce(nullif($6::int, 0), q.max_attempts), nullif($7::text, ''), nullif($8::text, '') FROM queues q WHERE q.name = $1 ON CONFLICT (queue, idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING RETURNING id
UPDATE jobs SET state = 'completed', finished_at = now(), lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = $1 AND state = 'leased' AND lease_token = $2 RETURNING queue
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM queues WHERE name = $1)
UPDATE jobs SET state = $5, last_error = $2, run_at = coalesce($3::timestamptz, now() + interval $6 * $4::bigint), lease_token = $7, lease_expires_at = $8 WHERE id = $1
SELECT id, queue, attempts, max_attempts, coalesce(last_error, '') FROM jobs WHERE state = 'leased' AND lease_expires_at < now() ORDER BY lease_expires_at LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
